title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Anthropic reintroduces Fable 5 to Max and Team Premium plans (Jul 20) at 50% of usage limits, with Pro / Team Standard on credits plus a one-time $100 credit
bullets.summary: Freshest dated item this window: starting today Claude Fable 5, Anthropic's most advanced model, is included in Max and Team Premium at 50% of limits, while Pro and Team Standard keep Fable access via usage credits and receive a one-time $100 credit — a model-entitlement change, not a new model.
bullets.how: This is about which top-tier model The Construct's agents may call and at what cost, not a new capability; worth a note in the model-selection policy (Fable 5 for the heaviest strategy/venture jobs, Sonnet 5 for volume), but nothing to migrate today.

bullets.title: Claude Code — /verify and /code-review are now invoke-only, plus a broad safety pass and live MCP connector data for published artifacts
bullets.summary: Stops Claude from auto-running the /verify and /code-review skills unless invoked directly, ships tighter permission checks and safer Bash/PowerShell handling with the EndConversation tool and progress heartbeats for long-running tasks, and adds live MCP connector data to published artifacts so an artifact can pull fresh connector data each time it is opened.
bullets.how: The invoke-only change touches how our scan agents run skills (confirmable first-hand this session), and live-connector artifacts fit The Construct dashboard surface directly: a published view should refresh from brand-insights/latest.json rather than freeze at publish time.

bullets.title: MCP spec 2026-07-28 is now 8 days out — final adds MCP Apps (server-rendered UIs) and a Tasks extension for long-running work on top of the stateless core
bullets.summary: Beyond the breaking stateless rewrite already flagged (initialize/initialized handshake and Mcp-Session-Id gone, Mcp-Method routing headers, ttlMs/cacheScope on list/read, OAuth/OpenID auth, -32002 to -32602), the final spec formally lands MCP Apps for server-rendered UI inside the client and a Tasks extension for long-running jobs.
bullets.how: Every MCP server The Construct runs is 8 days from a breaking change; MCP Apps is a genuinely new capability (an agent-callable server can render its own UI) and the Tasks extension maps to our long-running scan jobs. Run the one /doctor pass that yields both the unused-server list and the Jul-28 migration inventory before the deadline.

bullets.title: arXiv — The Orchestration of Multi-Agent Systems: Architectures, Protocols, and Enterprise Adoption unifies MCP tool access with the Agent2Agent protocol
bullets.summary: Formalizes a single architectural frame where agents reach tools via MCP and coordinate with each other via A2A, with explicit delegation and policy-enforcement layers — the current live research vein alongside AdaptOrch, MASPO joint prompt optimization, and RL-over-orchestration-traces in the same cluster.
bullets.how: Vocabulary and a governance frame for the fleet: The Construct already routes skills per task via MCP, but A2A (agent-to-agent) is a protocol dimension we do not yet use and should watch as the installed-skills registry grows. Borrow against CLAUDE.md governance, do not install today.

praxis_lesson: Still a quiet primary-release window — no new frontier model in the last 24h (GPT-5.6, Sonnet 5, Grok 4.5 all off-window) — but this later fire earns its keep by catching one genuinely fresh dated item the morning brief missed: the Jul-20 Fable 5 entitlement change into Max / Team Premium. Bank the dated fact and re-rank, don't manufacture novelty. The load-bearing action is still the /doctor pass yielding the unused-server list and the Jul-28 migration inventory (now 8 days out, adding MCP Apps + Tasks), and 'live MCP connector data for published artifacts' remains the exact mechanism that would keep the V4 dashboard fresh from latest.json instead of frozen at publish.
